data.title: Tropical Depression Fay (AT1), advisory 29/1448Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: FAY WEAKENS INTO A DEPRESSION. As of 11:00 AM AST Tue Sep 29 the center of Fay was located near 24.2, -47.3 with movement SW at 12 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1010 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 35 mph.

data.title: Tropical Storm Hanna (AT3), advisory 29/1449Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: HANNA MOVING SOUTHEASTWARD AND SLIGHTLY WEAKER. As of 11:00 AM AST Tue Sep 29 the center of Hanna was located near 34.6, -45.5 with movement SE at 12 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1004 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 40 mph.

data.title: Tropical Depression Nineteen-E (EP4), advisory 29/1449Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: NEW TROPICAL DEPRESSION EXPECTED TO BE SHORT-LIVED WELL OFFSHORE OF MEXICO. As of 8:00 AM PDT Tue Sep 29 the center of Nineteen-E was located near 14.4, -131.6 with movement E at 9 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1004 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 35 mph.

data.title: Hurricane Polo (EP2), advisory 29/1747Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: POLO MAKES LANDFALL A LITTLE EAST OF GUAYMAS MEXICO. ...HIGH WINDS AND HEAVY RAINS EXPECTED IN PORTIONS OF NORTHWESTERN MEXICO... As of 11:00 AM MST Tue Sep 29 the center of Polo was located near 28.0, -110.6 with movement NE at 17 mph. The minimum central pressure was 984 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 75 mph.

data.title: Tropical Storm Rachel (EP3), advisory 29/1749Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: RACHEL HOLDING STEADY SOUTH OF SOUTHWESTERN MEXICO. As of 12:00 PM CST Tue Sep 29 the center of Rachel was located near 15.7, -105.1 with movement NW at 12 mph. The minimum central pressure was 987 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 65 mph.
